method:
Collect scores8/<world>_b<block>.json + _F.npz (t8_score.py) into results.json and print a markdown table.

Per world, all on the same lives (paired per-life differences, mean +- SE):
  best reflex   better (on these lives) of reflex@hollow3 frozen and the in-world re-tune 'rt-mem'
  ceiling       C1 privileged pursuit - best reflex (C1 is a heuristic, so a lower bound on the true ceiling)
  info          best information-matched row (C5 ring4 / C5 hollow3, chosen on these lives) - best reflex
  do-less       best of the eight quieter / smaller reflex variants - best reflex (max over 8 on these lives)
  bigger body   best of router@ring4 / reflex@ring4 tissue bodies (no central computation) - best reflex
  memory        dark share = (dark captures info - dark captures reflex) / (captures info - captures reflex), the
                share of the info-matched controller's extra captures made while the target is dark (ledger col 21;
                bootstrap SE); C5 - [B: idles while it believes the target dark]; C5 - [A: no dark model];
                info gap here - info gap in base1 (per-life paired on the same seeds); privileged M1 decomposition
Verdict: ADMIT if info > 3 SE and >= 1 F and the do-less gap is clearly smaller (info - do-less > 3 SE, paired, and
do-less < half the info gap); NO_HEADROOM if the best known ceiling (max of C1 and info) is < 1 F over the reflex;
UNCLEAR otherwise.
usage: t9_summarize.py [--block 100] [--out results.json]
